_comment: EXAMPLE answers: the Google Play Data Safety declaration of the example app in legal-guardrails.md section 8 (a Firebase + RevenueCat wellness app with no health data). Copy this file into the person's project, set 'app' and every row from their own data surface, and keep that copy as the single source of truth for their declaration. Consumed by scripts/emit_play_csv.mjs via --answers. Reconcile 1:1 with the Privacy Policy's data and recipients sections, the Apple App Privacy label, any store-declaration notes the project keeps, and the legal-data-surface-scan android output before every submit. NOT 'Health & fitness' for an app that collects no health or fitness data (over-declaration trap). SHARED=false on every row here: Google/Firebase, RevenueCat and the stores act as PROCESSORS on the publisher's documented instructions, which Play's Data Safety guidance explicitly excludes from 'sharing' (transfer to a third party for their own purposes); the Privacy Policy's recipients section must say the same.
